subject: LAB-007
title: Add a pasted note and a pasted link from the share inbox, then reset the demo
provenance: Original synthetic script written for this project's LAB-007 qualification replay and distributed under its MIT License. Its seed is a byte-for-byte copy of the app's demo seed, Fixtures/demo/seed.json. Its two additions are what adding intake/harbor-walk.txt and the link https://example.org/tide-tables to the Field notes collection commits.
untested: The intake: the replay starts where the review ends. Pasting, choosing files, sharing, staging, and the inbox are exercised by ShareIngressShowcaseReplayTests in Packages/LabFeatures and by the Mac hosted tests.

The share-extension adapter: the runner is composed as the app UI, the adapter a pasted import is added as. The same additions from the share extension's folder commit as the share extension, and ShareIngressShowcaseReplayTests shows they reach the same state.
Images, movies, and chosen files: they stage and wait for review, but this build cannot add them to a collection, so they never reach the replay.
Host views and the receipt inspector: the replay renders nothing.
Physical devices and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

steps.description: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples: 3 collections and 12 items in the demo namespace.
New Collection… on the review screen creates one of the person's own collections, Field notes, because a demo collection cannot take an import.
The person's Add on the pasted note: a grant for exactly one new item in Field notes.

createItem.title: Harbor walk
createItem.note:
Harbor walk
Bring the blue notebook.

steps.description: Add the pasted note: its first line becomes the title and the whole text the note. The item and request IDs are the ones its content and the collection derive.
The person's Add on the pasted link: a grant for exactly one new item in Field notes.
Add the pasted link: with no page title, its host becomes the title and the address the note. The link is stored as text and never opened.
Find the added note by a word from it.
List Field notes, ordered by title: the link, then the note.
The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
Reset Demo finds the samples already as seeded and changes nothing: the imported items are the person's, not the demo's.
Both imported items are still in Field notes, unchanged.
